explanations: The fixture is built in `beforeAll`, so one ProviderCalendar is shared and mutated by every test. "books an open slot" books 9:00 for pt-100, so the last test "allows the first patient to book 9:00" throws SlotUnavailableError when the suite runs in file order, yet passes when run alone (e.g. with .only). Likewise the first test passes only because it runs before any booking. The tests are order-dependent; the setup should use `beforeEach` so each test gets a fresh calendar.

book() mutates the stored slot and returns a spread copy, so changing the copy's patientId leaves the stored slot booked and available() still excludes 10:00. patientId is not readonly, there is no database, and the map key is the unchanged ISO string.
cancel() returns false without changing anything when `slot.patientId !== patientId`. It never throws, and it only sets patientId to null and returns true for the matching patient.

openSlot only inserts when `!this.slots.has(k)`; with the key present, the call is a no-op. The slot is not replaced or updated, and the Map keyed by ISO string cannot hold two entries for the same start.
